paths.name: plain
paths.notes: hand lifts as the elbow folds and the blade turns onto its left side, then it drops into the wide left windup (the straight blend overreaches 0.34 m)

paths.name: recoil_fold
paths.notes: blade recoils up and flips onto its left side as the elbow folds, then drops into the left windup

paths.name: quiver
paths.notes: blade shivers in the target (jaw flick x1) before it comes away, folds up with the blade turning left, then swings down to the left windup
